summary: Modularize report conformance and harden O_NOFOLLOW reads, UTC date normalization, and schema caching

delivery.outcome: Decompose operations/conformance.py (485L) into <350L report_io.py, acceptance_conformance.py, and conformance.py; enforce O_NOFOLLOW regular-file and MAX_BYTES limits on all file reads, dir_fd traversal in validate_local, UTC date conversion, git timeouts, and schema validator caching.
nonGoals: No wire-schema or diagnostic code breaking changes.

architecture.decision: Extract descriptor-safe bounded I/O into operations/report_io.py and scoped acceptance conformance into operations/acceptance_conformance.py while keeping report validation, local readback, CLI, and re-exports in operations/conformance.py (<350L each, CC <= 12).
architecture.rollback: Revert commit on operations/ to restore single-file conformance module.
